The granularity or functional role of this [`MusicalSegment`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalSegment.md) (riff, motif, phrase, section, talea, color,...). Functional: a segment is of exactly one kind; contested categorisations are coexisting standpoints ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
